subject: Eval plan — confirm owners & target dates
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@lyrahealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <treynolds@lyrahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Eval plan — confirm owners & target dates

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Great conversation this morning — thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

• Objective: 2-week PoC to validate latency/cost for your clinical-notes summarization pipeline and evaluate integration with your ingestion layer.
• Success criteria (agreed): 95th-percentile inference latency < 250ms for 512-token requests; overall token cost below $0.0025/token during steady state; no PII leaving Lyra-managed VPC.

Mutual action plan attached (Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx). Requesting confirmation of the owner for each line item and a target date so we can route internal resources (SE time, dedicated capacity window). My suggested owners/dates are in column D/E — feel free to edit.

Key asks for you this week:
1) Confirm point people for: evaluation owner (business), technical owner, and procurement lead.
2) Confirm target week for PoC (we proposed Dec 7 — 13).
3) Any legal/procurement constraints we should surface now (NDA/standard SOW timeline).

I’ll hold the SE slot (Priyom) for Dec 8 until we hear back; if your preferred week shifts we can rebook.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a quick 15-min call to walk through the MAP if easier.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up on MAP (bump)

Hi Alicia —

Just wanted to bump this in case it got buried. We shared a short MAP on Friday to capture owners/dates for the PoC and hold Priyom’s SE slot on Dec 8. Can you confirm who on your side will own the evaluation and procurement items, or let me know if the proposed Dec 7 week needs to move?

If helpful I can send a one-line version that you can forward internally. Appreciate any update — even a quick "we’ll confirm next week" helps.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@lyrahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval plan — confirm owners & target dates

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. Apologies for the delay — I was out for most of last week. Quick update from our side: 

• Evaluation owner (business): Tom Reynolds (cc’d) — he’ll own stakeholder coordination and success criteria sign-off.
• Technical owner: Me (Alicia) — I’ll handle environment access and test dataset prep; Tom will loop in our infra lead if needed.
• Procurement lead: I’m assigning to Kelly Huang from Procurement (kelly.huang@lyrahealth.com) — she’ll own the contract/PO line and timeline.

Target timing: Dec 14 — 20 works better for the team (holiday calendars compressed earlier in December). Can you confirm Priyom’s availability that week? We’d like to keep it to a firm 2-week window and get a short statement from Legal about data residency before kickoff.

We don’t expect major legal hurdles — standard DPIA/controls review only. I’ll introduce Kelly on the thread once I have her ok.

Thanks,
Alicia
Sr. Product Manager, Data & Insights
Lyra Health

Thanks, Alicia — this is perfect and helpful. I’ve updated the MAP to reflect the owners and moved the PoC week to Dec 14 — 20 as requested (see attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1_updated.xlsx).

Actions I just took:
• Reserved Priyom’s SE slot for Dec 15–16.
• Noted procurement owner Kelly Huang and flagged the SOW path (we’ll provide a redlined SOW template once procurement confirms).
• Added a legal checkpoint for data residency sign-off prior to environment provisioning.

Next steps for the Lyra team: please confirm Kelly on the thread (or introduce via email) and confirm whether Dec 14 start is firm. If there are any procurement timing constraints that would push start into January, tell us now so we can adjust SE scheduling.

If helpful, I’m available for a 20-min alignment on Thursday to run through the MAP updates and block calendars.

Best regards,
